topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I was packing my bag for work when I saw a message from Alex. They mentioned a local event and casually pointed out it was in our city. I paused, then replied, "Funny, I live there too." Turns out, we've been neighbors for who knows how long, just in different neighborhoods. We decided to meet up at a coffee shop near the event. It was nice, easy to talk and catch up in person. We even found out we have a few mutual friends. Small world, huh? Plans are already made for a hike next weekend.
